method: Official website pages, live WordPress REST API posts and featured-media records, live theme CSS, and visual inspection of local seed images. No checkout files were changed.

brand.paletteNote: Logo samples are representative pixels from a JPEG gradient, not declared flat brand swatches. The live CSS accent is exact. Main visual elements are dark indigo Eastsider lettering, white News lettering, a yellow sun, and green/turquoise background.
brand.recommendation: Lead with green and turquoise, using deeper forest green for the masthead and principal surfaces and a restrained yellow sun detail. This follows Spencer’s direction on 13 October 2026 to restore the green identity. The logo pixel samples above remain a record of the original source.

identity.editorialMethod: Volunteer editorial committee assesses contributions before publication. Community contributors include regular writers and citizen journalists. Professional journalists are not employed according to the published Editorial Values page.
identity.philosophy: Local participation, diverse community voices, respectful evidence based discussion, clear separation of opinion from fact, accountability, privacy, and editorial independence from advertising.
identity.authorInformation: Published guidelines request the author's name and suburb. The follow-up email address is not for publication. A headshot and short biography are optional.
identity.subscriptionPurpose: Free alerts for new editions and reminders about contributions. Do not invent a daily or weekly newsletter promise.

implementationRecommendations: Use original headlines and meaningful source links for archive cards. Keep supplied articles in their authors' voices. Do not present machine-written seed summary bodies under the original author's byline.
Provide real author pages with verified names and linked contributions. Leave a missing biography or portrait absent until supplied, instead of inventing credentials.
Use a clear date and archive context for older articles, and calculate upcoming events in Australia/Melbourne. October 2026 Melbourne times use UTC+11.
Only populate photographer or image-credit fields where supported. For uncredited source images, a provenance link to the original article is accurate; an invented ownership credit is not.
Maintain separate content types for news, opinion, event listings and advertising so the community's contributors retain their distinct roles.
Keep editorial review before publication, including author name, consented biography, source links, image credit and rights, original publication date and meaningful correction history.
